🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义

ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 low：low
  3. 计算 volume：volume
  4. 计算 prior_peak：close.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=30).max().shift(5)
  5. 计算 drawdown_depth：(1.0 - close.shift(5) / prior_peak).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.8)
  6. 计算 prior_low：low.滚动窗口(15, min_periods=15).min().shift(1)
  7. 计算 recovery：close / prior_low - 1.0
  8. 计算 recovery_score：recovery.ewm(span=4, adjust=False, min_periods=4).mean() - 0.5 * drawdown_depth
  9. 计算 volume_base：volume.ewm(span=20, adjust=False, min_periods=20).mean()
  10. 计算 participation：(volume / volume_base - 1.0).clip(-1.0, 2.0)
  11. 计算 factor：recovery_score * (0.75 + 0.75 * drawdown_depth) * (1.0 + 0.3 * np.tanh(participation))
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_smoothed_drawdown_recovery_participation(df): """Measure sustained recovery ">class="kw">from a prior drawdown with smoothed participation confirmation.""" df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] low = df_copy["low"] volume = df_copy["volume"] prior_peak = close.rolling(30, min_periods=30).max().shift(5) drawdown_depth = (1.0 - close.shift(5) / prior_peak).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.8) prior_low = low.rolling(15, min_periods=15).min().shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan) recovery = close / prior_low - 1.0 recovery_score = recovery.ewm(span=4, adjust="kw">class="kw">False, min_periods=4).mean() - 0.5 * drawdown_depth volume_base = volume.ewm(span=20, adjust="kw">class="kw">False, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan) participation = (volume / volume_base - 1.0).clip(-1.0, 2.0) factor = recovery_score * (0.75 + 0.75 * drawdown_depth) * (1.0 + 0.3 * np.tanh(participation)) df_copy["factor_smoothed_drawdown_recovery_participation"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_smoothed_drawdown_recovery_participation"]
